stories.title: Two killed, 16 injured in school bus crash in eastern France
stories.summary: Two people died and 16 were hurt, three seriously, when an intercity school bus hit a tree near Lent in eastern France on Friday morning, French media reported.

stories.title: Giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang debut at Zoo Atlanta
stories.summary: The new pandas at Zoo Atlanta made their public debut Friday, returning the species to the zoo after a two-year absence under a 10-year loan from China.

stories.title: Belgium king rejects PM resignation over budget crisis
stories.summary: King Philippe refused the resignation of Prime Minister Bart De Wever and sent the five-party coalition back to negotiate a budget deal, keeping the government in place.

stories.title: Magnitude 6.1 quake strikes off Japan east coast, no tsunami alert
stories.summary: A shallow magnitude 6.1 earthquake struck off the Kanto coast of Japan on Friday, with shaking felt in central Tokyo; no tsunami alert was issued and no immediate damage was reported.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO valuation talks drop to about $1.1T after AI selloff
stories.summary: Prospective buyers are now discussing an Anthropic valuation of $1.2T to $1.3T, some as low as $1.1T, down from $2T in early October as post-election selloff pressure mounts.

stories.title: Democrats eye Nvidia chip exports and circular AI financing for oversight
stories.summary: A newly Democratic Congress is lining up oversight of Nvidia chip exports and circular AI financing, adding regulatory scrutiny to the AI buildout.

stories.title: Nvidia mandates GPU location tracking for Southeast Asia cloud partners
stories.summary: Nvidia is requiring Southeast Asian customers to log the physical location of AI accelerators to keep cloud-partner status, aiming to curb smuggling of banned chips into China.

stories.title: Swiss startup Embodied AI unveils humanoid robot Air
stories.summary: Embodied AI showed off Air, a wheeled humanoid with tendon-driven arms that learns factory tasks by watching workers, hitting 98% reliability on a cable-handling evaluation.

stories.title: Browns Denzel Boston cleared to face Saints
stories.summary: Wide receiver Denzel Boston was a full participant in practice Friday and carries no injury designation for the game Sunday at New Orleans.

stories.title: Browns plan to keep Jerry Jeudy unless a crazy offer arrives
stories.summary: Cleveland expects to hold onto receiver Jerry Jeudy through the trade deadline Tuesday unless it gets a truly crazy offer, preserving veteran depth for the playoff push.

stories.title: Shedeur Sanders to start for Browns vs. Saints
stories.summary: Shedeur Sanders will start at quarterback Sunday at New Orleans with Deshaun Watson in concussion protocol, though Watson could still be cleared Saturday.

stories.title: Deshaun Watson returns to practice, still in concussion protocol
stories.summary: Watson was back on the field Friday for the first time since entering the concussion protocol, but he remains in the protocol and needs clearance Saturday to play.

stories.title: Ryan Day: Julian Sayin healing, no timetable for return
stories.summary: Ohio State coach Ryan Day says quarterback Julian Sayin is healing from his arm injury with no return date, likely sidelining him for the rest of the regular season.

stories.title: Buckeyes playoff path: ranked No. 12, must win out while Sayin recovers
stories.summary: Ohio State is the first team out of the College Football Playoff at No. 12 and must beat Oregon, Nebraska and Michigan to stay alive with Sayin sidelined.

stories.title: Eleven Warriors preview: Buckeyes need everyone behind Luke Fahey vs. Oregon
stories.summary: The Oregon game Saturday shapes up as a must-win for Ohio State, with Luke Fahey making his second start at quarterback for the 6-2 Buckeyes.

stories.title: ESPN model predicts a Buckeyes win over Oregon
stories.summary: ESPN projects Ohio State to beat Oregon on Saturday, keeping the Buckeyes in the Big Ten title and College Football Playoff picture.

stories.title: Toto Wolff offers first insight into Haas axing Esteban Ocon
stories.summary: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff said Haas team principal Ayao Komatsu had no choice but to protect the team when it dropped Ocon for the final four races, speaking publicly for the first time.

stories.title: Ferrari holds clear-the-air talks between Hamilton and Leclerc
stories.summary: Team principal Fred Vasseur said he reminded both drivers of their responsibility to the team after their Mexico first-lap clash, adding they will turn the page ahead of Sao Paulo.

stories.title: F1 keeps Qatar and Abu Dhabi finale on schedule despite security concerns
stories.summary: F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali says the Gulf finale remains the plan while contingency preparations stay active, with teams seeking reassurance over regional security.

stories.title: George Russell takes five-place grid penalty at Sao Paulo GP
stories.summary: Russell will start no higher than sixth after a fresh Mercedes engine triggers a five-place penalty at Interlagos, where Mercedes can clinch the constructors title.

stories.title: Former Faith Life Church leader found guilty on all counts
stories.summary: Gary Keesee Jr. was convicted Friday of 11 counts of rape, 11 counts of gross sexual imposition and 5 counts of unlawful sexual conduct with a minor.

stories.title: Two family members shot and killed in Delaware
stories.summary: A man and a woman died Friday morning after a domestic shooting at a Delaware home; police say the incident was isolated with no ongoing threat to the community.
